name: study-squad
description: A four-role study team that archives courseware into Markdown, solves practice problems with citations, and runs spaced-repetition review.

displayDescription.en: Turns your courseware and textbooks into a searchable Markdown library, answers practice problems with exact citations, logs mistakes, and schedules spaced review so a course actually sticks.
displayDescription.zh: 课件课本转Markdown归档，刷题解答标注出处，错题易错点自动沉淀，按遗忘曲线安排复习。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们开始学这门课：先建好学习目录，把我给的课件和课本转成Markdown归档，再带我过一遍本章重点
defaultInitPrompt.en: Let's start this course: set up the study folders, convert my courseware and textbook into organized Markdown, then walk me through this chapter's key points

quickPrompts.en: Let's start this course: set up the study folders, convert my courseware and textbook into organized Markdown, then walk me through this chapter's key points
quickPrompts.zh: 我们开始学这门课：先建好学习目录，把我给的课件和课本转成Markdown归档，再带我过一遍本章重点

quickPrompts.en: I'm doing practice problems: [paste problem]. Answer using the textbook's own framing, cite the source, and log it in my practice records
quickPrompts.zh: 我在刷题：〔粘贴题目〕。有答案就按答案口径讲，没有就自己解，必须引用课件或课本出处，并记入刷题记录

quickPrompts.en: Review this week's study with me: update chapter summaries, problem-solving techniques, common mistakes, and my next review schedule
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我复盘这段时间的学习：更新知识点总结、解题技巧和易错点，并告诉我今天该复习哪些错题
